description: Reverse DNS (PTR) for up to 20 IPv4 / IPv6 addresses with forward-confirmed reverse DNS (FCrDNS: does the PTR hostname resolve back to the same IP?), PTR name, TTL and NXDOMAIN / SERVFAIL status, over DNS-over-HTTPS. Useful for mail-server checks, log enrichment and bot verification (e.g. is this really Googlebot). Returns JSON with: count, results, resolver. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/reverse-dns
